normalLayoutScale.methodology: Actual native Electron dev renderer, production UI and stores, packed default adapters and source browser. Synthetic metadata; normal layout retained, with the first of 100,000 document buffers active; no pane-suppression override. Input DOM allocations precede the manager baseline. Timings include synchronous React search handlers; cold time includes Playwright and UI mount. Resident memory measured with Electron process metrics after forced GC; production file ingestion, other panel/view combinations and transient pre-GC peaks are not certified. Loopback mock model, no real inference or R source reads.

defaultAdapters.methodology: Actual default workspace/document/console adapters and broker. All manager construction and query allocations counted from immutable input snapshots. Input-store allocations and combined total also reported separately; no R/model/read dispatch. Node synthetic adapter evidence, not native UI/platform or task-quality certification.

failedAttempts.interpretation: Initial native runs exposed and then verified fixes for schema hydration, compressed HEAD/cancellation and the protocol-aware race harness. One full-suite folder fixture timed out under load; isolated and bounded-concurrency full retries passed. A development module URL falsely matched the old schema-read detector; exact endpoint detection fixes that harness issue. Wide/reference viewport latency failures and a startup timeout remain preserved. Actual broad-search ranking was improved; the fixed viewport and all unchanged performance limits are recorded in the final scale report.
